newsitem.title: SPAIN: Retevision - Endesa group bid exceeds BCH group bid.
newsitem.headline: Retevision - Endesa group bid exceeds BCH group bid.

text.p: The offer for Retevision from the consortium headed by Spain's Endesa exceeded by more than 32 billion pesetas the offer presented by the BCH consortium, secretary general of Retevision Jose Manuel Garcia-Mon said on Tuesday.
Retevision is to become Spain's second basic telephone operator.
The Endesa consortium, which includes Italy's Stet, bid a total of 116.36 billion pesetas while the BCH consortium, which comprises France Telecom and U.S. operator Sprint bid 84.0 billion pesetas.

When making the decision on who will win the auction, Spain's Contracts Commission will give 40 percent of the weighting to the highest bidder, 20 percent for infrastructure and networks, 20 percent for finanical backing and strategic plan, 10 percent for experience, and 10 percent for service improvement and benefit to the Spanish economy.
